name: SQANTI-evidence benchmark
description: Annotations, run configurations, analysis code, derived tables and figure scripts of the benchmark of SQANTI-evidence v1.1.0, a workflow that annotates a genome from long-read RNA-seq alone, without a reference annotation or a protein database. Eight species with a reference annotation and public long-read data (Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Caenorhabditis elegans, Arabidopsis thaliana, Drosophila melanogaster, Gallus gallus, Danio rerio, Mus musculus, Homo sapiens) were annotated with SQANTI-evidence and compared with BRAKER3, run on the same reads and the same protein evidence, and with BRAKER4, run with the OrthoDB v12 clade proteins. Yeast has no BRAKER arm, because GeneMark-ETP does not run on it.The record contains two archives. The annotation archive holds one file per species and arm: SQANTI-evidence with the default filter (the arm reported in the manuscript) and with the original strict filter, both as GFF3 in which every model carries its origin (tier=SQANTI_curated for curated long-read transcripts, tier=Augustus for predictions at loci without read support); and the BRAKER3 and BRAKER4 outputs as written by BRAKER (GTF, seven species). It also holds the tables of the filter-design analysis. The code archive holds the configuration of every run, the analysis scripts, the derived tables (GffCompare and GAQET2 summaries, isoform recovery, UTR accuracy) and the R scripts that rebuild the figures of the manuscript.
